name: Gold-led debasement joint rally — LONG crypto when gold surges WITHOUT a fear tell (the other side of the decoupling)
rationale: MECHANISM: the OPPOSITE-SIGN expression of the gold-crypto relationship, isolating the debasement regime the short variants must avoid. When gold_xau surges but there is NO risk-off fear tell (vix_level stays LOW), the gold bid is a monetary-debasement / weak-dollar play — and in that regime crypto is a CO-BENEFICIARY 'harder money' asset, not a victim. So a gold up-thrust in a calm-VIX regime is a LONG signal for crypto beta, confirmed by crypto momentum turning up (positive ret_Nd). This directly harvests the joint-rally regime that makes the naive gold-fade short backwards. Counterparty = traders mechanically shorting crypto on any gold strength. DISCONFIRMER: the gold-crypto correlation trended to ZERO from Feb 2025 (coinmetrics), so gold strength may carry NO crypto information at all in calm regimes — the signal could be pure noise. Kill unless OOS shows calm-VIX gold surges genuinely precede crypto strength net of fees, and unless it beats a bare crypto-momentum long WITHOUT the gold gate (gold must add lift, not decorate momentum).
catalyst: gold surge in a calm-VIX regime (debasement) with crypto momentum turning up
